purpose: Preserve controlled PPSSPP career-mode runtime observations and RAM correlations gathered from retail Fight Night Round 3 PSP savestates. No savestate, RAM dump, game binary, or copyrighted payload is committed by this artifact.

savestate_extraction.verification_note: The 32 MiB region at decompressed offset 0x48 matched the previously extracted baseline RAM byte-for-byte at multiple nonzero offsets. This rule was then applied consistently to checkpoints 0-5.

private_artifact_hashes.policy: Hashes only. The corresponding .ppst and extracted RAM files must remain outside Git.

field_evidence.name: player_training_attribute_block
field_evidence.evidence: The first two fields track the known Power -4 and Power +3 deltas exactly. Three later fields each increase by +1 when the visible result reports Stamina +1, Body +1, and Cuts +1. Exact mapping of those three addresses remains unresolved because all three changed by the same amount in the same experiment. Four intermediate fields stayed fixed during the second training result where Speed, Agility, Chin, and Heart were all +0.

implementation_relevance: The career bank, rival names, player boxer identity, wins/KO candidates, and training attribute block provide concrete runtime anchors for watchpoints and writer-function tracing.

The formatted Career Central and Scheduled Fight parameter strings expose game-facing semantic names such as strWinLossRecord, strRank, strMoney, strRivalName, strDate, strEventName, strRoundInfo, strCutPercentage, and strRules.
Checkpoint comparisons demonstrate that PPSSPP savestates can replace manual RAM dumps for controlled career reverse engineering.
unresolved_questions: Distinguish 0x08D98504 from 0x08D98506 by recording a decision win where wins increase but KOs do not.
Resolve exact meanings of 0x08D98568 and 0x08D98578 using another payout and a later bank state.
Resolve the three +1 training fields at 0x08D9AAC2, 0x08D9AAC8, and 0x08D9AACA using training results where Stamina, Body, and Cuts change by different amounts.
Determine why two adjacent u16 fields at 0x08D9AABA and 0x08D9AABC mirror the visible Power delta; possibilities such as duplicated/current-base/left-right values remain unproven.
Trace reads/writes of confirmed runtime fields back to retail BOOT.BIN functions before assigning implementation hooks.
